definitions.explanation: The southernmost point of the Earth, or the Antarctic region in general. Used in geographic, scientific, and general contexts.

examples.japanese: {南極|なんきょく}はとても{寒|さむ}い。
{南極|なんきょく}{大陸|たいりく}にはペンギンがいる。
examples.english: There are penguins on the Antarctic continent.

examples.japanese: {日本|にほん}の{観測隊|かんそくたい}が{南極|なんきょく}で{調査|ちょうさ}を{行|おこな}っている。
examples.english: A Japanese observation team is conducting research in the Antarctic.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{南極|なんきょく}{大陸|たいりく} (Antarctic continent)
・{南極|なんきょく}{点|てん} (South Pole, the exact point)
・{南極|なんきょく}{観測|かんそく} (Antarctic observation/research)
・{南極|なんきょく}{探検|たんけん} (Antarctic expedition)

RELATED WORDS:
The opposite is {北極|ほっきょく} (North Pole / Arctic). Japan has maintained a continuous Antarctic research presence since 1957, and the {南極|なんきょく}{観測隊|かんそくたい} (Antarctic observation team) is well known.
